name: Toyota Crown, 12th generation (S180, 2003-2008: V6 2.5 / 3.0 / 3.5, rear drive, automatic, four-door saloon; trims Royal and Athlete). In the game: TAITO 크렘린 (part lines 차르 = Royal, 올림픽 = Athlete)
model: none yet: the body (차체 C, K1) waits for the N33 method gate (docs/systems/117 §15-16)
axes: mm; x from the nose tip (0) back to the tail (4840); y half-width from the centre line; z from the ground
approximate: values marked [~] are read loosely from the drawings or from general sources outside the repository; K4 checks the machinery against the game's figures

tolerance.overall: makers' figures: exact (length 4840, wheelbase 2850, width 1780, height 1470); the drawings agree on length to 0.2 % and on height to 1.5 %
tolerance.tracks: [~] 1530 front, 1540 rear (the usual quoted figures; not on the drawings)
tolerance.overhangs: +-20: 805 front, 1185 rear (the line drawing's axles at 98 and 403 px, nose 12, tail 529; at 9.34 mm/px 803 and 1177, made up to the maker's 4840 at the tail)
tolerance.profile: +-25 in z on the centre line (the line drawing every 15 px, about 140 mm: coarse); +-40 where only photographs show it (the lamps round the corners, the grille's depth, the bumpers' lower edges)
tolerance.plan: +-30 on the outline after the plan is scaled across to 1780 (see drawingChecks)
tolerance.parts: the faces (lamps, grille, bumpers, tail lamps) from the photographs only: no front or rear photograph at a true angle yet (see photosNeeded)

sources: docs/reference/kremlin/bp_line_4view.gif (780x397): four views, line drawing (its grille drawn as a mesh, so likely an Athlete [~]; the main source; 9.34 mm/px along, about 9.45 up)

docs/reference/kremlin/kit_paint_4view.jpg (622x897): a model kit's paint sheet, four views (its grille drawn as a mesh: which trim is not certain); the same projection and size as the line drawing (wheelbase 305 px), a scan tilted about 1.3 degrees: panel lines, glass edges, door cuts; not for numbers
docs/reference/kremlin/photo_*.webp: Royal front and rear three-quarters, Athlete front and rear three-quarters (faces, lamps, grilles, wheels)

docs/reference/kremlin/wire/maya_4view.webp: someone's 3D model in orthographic views, the NEXT generation's face (trapezoid grille, long swept lamps): proportions and surface flow only; its side view's tail and its plan's tail are cut off by the viewport
docs/reference/kremlin/interior/*: rear seats (grey cloth, beige) and a game model with the doors open (layout only); the black leather sunroof picture was the next generation and is out

drawingChecks.lineSide: nose px 12, tail px 529 (517 px); the tyres' contact points px 98 and 403 (305 px = 2850: 9.34 mm/px), so the length reads 4830 (maker 4840, -0.2 %); ground row 390.5, roof row 235 (the aerial's stub above it, rows 232-234): 155.5 px = 1452 at 9.34, the maker's 1470 gives 9.45 mm/px up (1.2 % taller than along: z read at 9.45)
drawingChecks.lineTyre: the front tyre's outline rows about 315-390 (75 px = 700 mm) against a 215/55 R17's 668 [~]: the drawn tyre is about 5 % large, or its top is the arch's lip; tyres are set from the real size, not the drawing
drawingChecks.linePlan: x 14-532 (518 px = 4838 at 9.34: agrees); the body's widest (no mirrors) rows 15-211 = 197 px = 1840: drawn 3.4 % wide, scaled by 0.967 across; mirrors to rows 4 and 221 at x 194
drawingChecks.lineFrontRear: front view rows 237-389 (152 px), body width below the mirrors 196 px (rows 296-384), mirrors 218 px; if its height is 1470 (9.67 mm/px) its width reads 1895: drawn 6.5 % wide against its height, scaled by 0.939 across; the rear view the same within a pixel (194 px, rows 47-200)
drawingChecks.kitSheet: side x 52-569 (517 px), tyre contacts px 138 and 443 (305 px): the line drawing's projection again at 9.34 mm/px; roof row 431, ground about 586; the plan tilted (its top edge falls 7 px over 300); usable for where lines run, not for measures
drawingChecks.wire: side view: tyre contacts about px 188 and 466 (278 px: about 10.25 mm/px), nose px 549, roof about px 485 to ground 623 (about 1420-1470); front overhang about 850 (the next generation's longer nose); tail cut off at the viewport's edge (px 73): no length
drawingChecks.verdict: the line drawing is the scale source at 9.34 mm/px: coarse against the 5-6 mm/px the 599 and the N33 were built on. Good enough for the profile to about +-25 mm and the plan after its 0.967 correction; not good enough for the face. The shape gate (same-angle photo comparison) needs the photographs below

photosNeeded: a straight side view (90 degrees, long lens) of a Royal and of an Athlete: the belt line, the door cuts, the arches' lips, the sill, the deck's height (the gate's main picture for K1)
a straight front view (0 degrees, at lamp height): the Royal's chrome vertical-bar grille and the Athlete's mesh grille, the lamps' outline and their inner layout, the bumper's openings and fog lamps
a straight rear view: the tail lamps' outline (the Athlete's smoked), the boot lid's plate recess, the exhausts

front three-quarter and rear three-quarter at about 30-35 degrees, camera at about 1.2 m, with the focal length known (the four we have are this kind but their lens and height are unknown): the camera the gate renders with
a top or high three-quarter view: the bonnet's crease lines and the roof's plan
the engine bay (bonnet open) and the dashboard: K2 and K4, not the shape gate

powertrain.layout: front engine, longitudinal; rear drive (four-wheel-drive versions existed: not in the game)

engines.engine: V6 2.5 L, DOHC 24 valves, direct injection [~]

powertrain.gearbox: torque-converter automatic: 6-speed on the rear-drive cars, 5-speed on the early and four-wheel-drive ones [~]; the game's automatic (race/autobox.ts) gives 4, 5 or 6

chassis.steering: rack, hydraulic or electric power assistance [~]

landmarks._: x mm from the nose, z mm, read on the line drawing's side view (9.34 along, 9.45 up) along its top outline: [~] to +-25 in z, +-70 in x (one sample every 15 px)
landmarks.sideNotes: the belt line runs straight from the mirror to the C-pillar's foot and rises a little into the boot; the rear door's window seems to end in a small fixed quarter glass at the C-pillar [~]; the boot lid's edge is near flat; read off the kit sheet, to be measured on a straight side photograph
